advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm that a container criterion reviewed over an empty child roster should be withheld (unrecoverable) rather than admitted as a faithful zero-child case.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_admission.py:337: `    if not isinstance(children, list) or not children:`
src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_admission.py:338: `        return False`

Container criteria include decomp-shape (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/container_stage.py:36 `CONTAINER_CRITERIA = ("G3", "G4", "decomp-shape")`), which may legitimately score a childless/empty decomposition.
advisory.finding: _children_are_replayable returns False for an empty or missing children list, so a container-criterion review over a parent with genuinely no reviewed children is classified unrecoverable-material and never dispatched, rather than admitted.
scenarios: A G4/decomp-shape review of a parent that was reviewed with an empty roster is withheld as unrecoverable-material instead of replayed.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a corpus test with a CREATE event whose ts > review_ts and assert the row is unverified/withheld (create_found treated as False).
evidence: src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py:167: `creates = [e for e in ticket_events.get("CREATE", []) if e["ts"] <= review_ts]`
test_build_corpus_marks_container_row_unverified_when_child_material_unrecoverable exercises a child with no CREATE event (`tracker.create(parent_id, ...)` only), not a CREATE with ts > review_ts

Named violating input: a ticket whose only CREATE event has ts strictly greater than the review_ts — must now yield create_found=False (row withheld) whereas the pre-change unfiltered code returned create_found=True
advisory.finding: The newly added CREATE-after-review filter in _reconstruct_material (`creates = [e for e in ticket_events.get("CREATE", []) if e["ts"] <= review_ts]`) has no test. The new unrecoverable-material test exercises create_found=False via a child that has NO CREATE event at all, which is a different path; no test provides a CREATE event whose ts is strictly greater than review_ts to prove the filter now excludes it (previously the unfiltered creates[0] would have been used, yielding create_found=True).
scenarios: A ticket created (or a child created) after the review timestamp within the same history walk

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Assert the sidecar row's top-level 'title' reflects the parent's at-review (CREATE+EDIT) title.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py:311: `"title": title,`
The only child-title assertion is in test_build_corpus_persists_child_title_and_description_at_review on row['children']; no test reads the parent row's top-level 'title' field
advisory.finding: The parent-side reconstructed `title` newly emitted into the sidecar row (`"title": title` in _build_sidecar_row) is never asserted. The child title-through-EDIT replay is checked, but no test asserts the parent row's own title reflects CREATE+EDIT replay at review_ts.
scenarios: A parent ticket whose title was edited before the review

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm gating the whole sidecar row's verification on children_reconstructed (vs. gating only container-criterion admission) is intended, given it withholds non-container coverage when a child CREATE is unrecoverable.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py:293: `    if create_found and children_reconstructed:`
A sidecar row is emitted per REVIEW_RESULT event, not per criterion: src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py:328-332 loops `for review_event in by_type.get("REVIEW_RESULT", [])`

The fingerprint basis uses only child ticket-ids, so child title/description are irrelevant to a match: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/material_diff.py:142 `"children": sorted(c.get("ticket_id", "") for c in ctx.children),`

Previously the parent context was built from child ids alone (`[{"ticket_id": c} for c in children]`) and could verify; now `children_reconstructed=False` forces `generation=None` / `verified=False` regardless of a would-be fingerprint match.
blocking.finding: corpus._build_sidecar_row gates the entire per-review sidecar row's verification on children_reconstructed, so a single unrecoverable child CREATE now marks the whole review row unverified for ALL criteria — not just container criteria (G3/G4/decomp-shape) — even though the material fingerprint only depends on child ticket-ids, not per-child title/description.
scenarios: A review over a parent whose child ticket had its CREATE event compacted/unrecoverable, but which was scored for non-container criteria — the row is now dropped from the corpus for those criteria too.
